description: Host health uses cluster and Host instance; capacity uses cluster and label_group; workload counts use cluster and namespace. Requests describe scheduling, not actual host consumption. Gaps mean missing samples, not recovery.

panels.title: Min Available RAM
panels.description: Worst host, including kernel memory. Below 15% leaves little headroom; below 8% is critical.

panels.title: Max Kernel / RAM
panels.description: Includes kernel BPF map allocations. Sustained growth can exhaust a node while pod memory looks normal.

panels.title: Failed Targets (5m)
panels.description: Core monitoring targets with at least one failed scrape in the last 5 minutes; this is not the number of nodes.

panels.title: Restarts (10m)
panels.description: Cluster-wide count across all namespaces. A last termination reason of Completed does not hide a liveness restart.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (cluster, node) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[10m]) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(node) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"})))

panels.title: Liveness Fails (5m)
panels.description: Failed liveness checks in the last 5 minutes. Zero is supplied only for a successfully scraped kubelet probes endpoint.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (cluster, instance) (increase(prober_probe_total{cluster=~"$cluster",probe_type="Liveness",result="failed"}[5m])) or on (cluster, instance) (0 * max by (cluster, instance) (up{cluster=~"$cluster",job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/probes"} == 1)))

panels.title: Nodes Not Ready
panels.description: Ready can remain true during a short node stall; also inspect host memory, PSI, and scrape failures.

panels.title: Kernel Vmalloc by Instance
panels.description: Kernel virtual allocations backed by memory, including BPF hash maps. Look for growth across hours or days; not equivalent to pod RSS.

panels.title: Memory / I/O Stall Time (PSI)
panels.description: Percentage of wall time with tasks stalled on memory or I/O. Missing PSI is not a zero.

panels.title: Swap In / Out by Instance
panels.description: Pages per second. Swap activity can indicate host pressure even when Kubernetes MemoryPressure stays false.

panels.title: Load per CPU Core
panels.description: Runnable and uninterruptible tasks per CPU core; includes I/O waits, unlike CPU utilization.

targets.expr: node_load1{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"} / on (cluster, instance) group_left count by (cluster, instance) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mode="idle"})

sum by (cluster, instance) (increase(prober_probe_total{cluster=~"$cluster",probe_type="Liveness",result="failed"}[5m])) or on (cluster, instance) (0 * max by (cluster, instance) (up{cluster=~"$cluster",job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/probes"} == 1))

panels.title: Core Target Scrape Health
panels.description: 1 = successful scrape, 0 = failure, gap = missing samples. Includes both API servers and worker monitoring endpoints.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, node) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[10m]) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(node) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

panels.title: Major Page Faults by Instance
panels.description: Major faults per second require fetching pages; correlate with swap activity and memory PSI.

targets.expr:
sum(kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) /
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource=~"pods"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) * 100

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource=~"cpu"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) /
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource=~"cpu"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) * 100

sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource=~"memory"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) /
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource=~"memory"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) * 100

panels.title: Memory Requests / Allocatable
panels.description: Scheduling reservation only. Kernel memory, page cache, and usage above requests are not represented.

panels.title: Cordoned Nodes
panels.description: Unschedulable nodes, not a readiness or connectivity check.

panels.title: Pod Memory / Capacity
panels.description: Pod working sets exclude host kernel allocations. Container and parent cgroup values must not be added together; see Host health above for actual node pressure.

panels.title: Container Restarts (10m)
panels.description: Number of restarts during the last 10 minutes, including kube-system; not restarts per second.

title: Kubernetes Cluster - Prometheus
